evidence.rationale: The defect the North Star names. The raw solve declared its 3 net keypoints at 0.9144 m while the labels are at ~0 m, so its own correspondence set was wrong. Held-out median plane error 2.7452 -> 0.1770 m (-93.6%) and held-out median reprojection 23.317 -> 8.772 px (-62.4%): both held-out criteria agree by a wide margin.
